description: Write several PLANNED articles one after another, and publish each one when publish is true: the next ones in calendar order (next), or the ones you name (contentIds). Each article follows Write now's rules: Auto-write off, next in line, up to 3 days before its day, at most 5 in any 24 hours. News and trending articles are written but never published by a run. Defaults to a DRY RUN that lists what would be written and what would stop it. When the person asked for this, call it with confirm=true. Follow progress with get_write_runs.

confirm.description: Set true to start (default: dry run)

contentIds.description: Planned article ids, instead of next

next.description: How many of the next planned articles to write

publish.description: Publish each article once it is written

name: write_articles
